ticker_news.title: 4 Brilliant Reasons Why Apple Should Buy Bitcoin
ticker_news.description: The article argues that Apple should invest in Bitcoin, as the cryptocurrency has seen significant price appreciation and could be a value-accretive asset for the company's balance sheet.
ticker_news.author: Neil Patel

ticker_news.title: Broadcom Q4 Preview: Bullish Setup Hinges on Positive Earnings and Guidance
ticker_news.description: Broadcom's Q4 earnings are expected to be a catalyst for the stock, with a bullish setup hinging on positive earnings and guidance. The company's focus on shifting VMware products to a subscription-based model and its strong partner base, including Apple, Alphabet, and Meta, suggest potential for growth.
ticker_news.author: Ali Merchant
